name: Two-column
use: read a detail: label over value, two to a row (a pen sheet, a feed formula, a sow record)
notUse: a figure the worker taps or edits (use Row, or a link below the facts); facts never act. Short counts, three across: use Three-column

name: Three-column
use: three short counts side by side (alive, identified, without identity)
notUse: values longer than a few characters or four or more facts (use Two-column)

name: Figures
use: the two or three figures a sheet is about to commit (Born 14 · Alive 9 · Dead 5), or a summary of counts: label over a large figure
notUse: a figure the worker taps or edits (use Row); a fact with a unit, a trail or a long value (use Two-column); more than three figures; a figure that opens something, because facts never act
